title: NOAA Optimum Interpolation SST v2.1: daily sea-surface temperature, its anomaly, and sea-ice concentration
provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (Huang et al. 2021), preliminary (near-real-time) analyses, served by NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP (ncdcOisst21NrtAgg_LonPM180)

start.description: First day (UTC); 'last' is the latest analysis, about two days old

stride.description: Take every n-th point of the 0.25° grid: 2 gives 0.5°

variables.description: Comma-separated: sst, anom (anomaly from 1991–2020), ice (concentration), err

format: netCDF classic; float32; degree_C; ice as a fraction; daily means stamped at 12:00 UTC; latitude ascending, longitude −180° to 180°
coverage: Global ocean, 0.25° grid, daily from 2020-05 to about two days ago
licence: US Government work, public domain; ERDDAP: "The data may be used and redistributed for free but is not intended for legal use, since it may contain inaccuracies."
citation: Huang, B., et al. (2021). Improvements of the Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (DOISST) Version 2.1. J. Climate 34, 2923–2939. doi:10.1175/JCLI-D-20-0166.1
